ORIGIN.quote: The fact that many labels explicitly invoke “OpenAI” is suggestive but not provenance proof.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader takes away that many agent labels say "OpenAI" and that this bears on where the swarm came from, but the report immediately discounts it as unprovable and elsewhere warns that a page name containing "OpenAI" "is not evidence of an AI origin," closing with "the exact operator attribution remains unresolved." That is more than bare unremarked evidence (above 0.2) because the report itself frames the labels as touching provenance, but it never lets OpenAI stand as a live candidate operator (below 0.6) — it raises the inference only to set it aside.
